correctness.rationale: Direct tangent projection of the explicit cubic counterterm reproduces minus every harmonic in the source's Eq. (55); a deterministic numerical identity check gives a 4.441e-16 maximum residual over 375 evaluations.

originality.rationale: The new source presents only partial compensation and omits the resonant pairwise monomial z_j^2 conjugate(z_i) from its claimed cubic enumeration. No source-specific complete second-order cubic counterterm or correction was found; general synchronization engineering is excluded from the novelty claim.

value.rationale: The result converts a reported partial-design limitation into a constructive complete order-epsilon^2 cancellation theorem and identifies the missing physical control direction needed for second harmonics.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
